characters.summary: Big Bird is Sesame Street's 8'2" yellow bird: gentle, non-violent and athletic for his size (he roller skates, ice skates, dances and rides a unicycle).

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

limitations: Non-combatant; the source documents no fights or strength feats

sources.supports: Big Bird: an 8'2" yellow bird; can roller skate, ice skate, dance, sing, write poetry, draw and ride a unicycle; in Follow That Bird he is kidnapped and dyed blue by two carnival owners; no fights or strength feats described.

feats.claim: Can roller skate, ice skate, dance and ride a unicycle despite standing 8'2".

unknowns: No combat, strength or durability feats are documented; he is a peaceful character.

characters.summary: Bobo the Bear is a jovial but bumbling bear, best known as the security guard at the KMUP studio on Muppets Tonight; he later plays assistants and stage managers.
limitations: Described as bumbling; no combat training or physical feats are documented

sources.supports: Bobo: 'jovial but bumbling security guard at the KMUP TV studio' on Muppets Tonight; Rentro, assistant to K. Edgar Singer in Muppets from Space; Tex Richman's assistant in The Muppets (2011); airport security guard in Letters to Santa; photo caption of him 'giving Kermit a bear hug'; no height or fights described.

feats.claim: Served as the (bumbling) security guard at the KMUP studio on Muppets Tonight.

unknowns: No documented height, so giant-sized was removed.
No fights or strength feats are documented.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

sources.supports: Boober: worries about doom and disease; 'easily frightened and suffers from a variety of phobias'; owns a book of superstitions and a lucky charm for almost anything; loves laundry and cooking; alter ego Sidebottom; in 'The Glow' his baloobius glows, which The Archivist calls a special gift.

feats.claim: Repeatedly played tricks on Wembley to test his baloobius ("Scared Silly").

unknowns: What, if anything, his glowing baloobius ("The Glow") can do in a fight.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

limitations: No combat role; the source only infers strength from his size

sources.supports: Bruno the Trashman: 'a large, full-body Muppet'; Oscar's friend and 'personal chauffeur', 'diligently carrying Oscar's trash can'; 'sheer size suggested considerable strength'; tenure c. 1979-1993; no height given.

feats.claim: Routinely carried Oscar's trash can, with Oscar inside, around Sesame Street.

characters.summary: Cantus is the enigmatic bard who leads the Minstrels, a group of traveling musicians; he plays a magic pipe, and flowers bloom around him when he plays.
limitations: Documented magic is non-combat (making flowers bloom, music)

sources.supports: Cantus: 'enigmatic bard', leader of the traveling Minstrels; 'plays a magic pipe, capable of producing songs when other Fraggles simply blow into it'; 'whenever he plays, the flowers around him go into full bloom'.

feats.claim: When he plays his pipe, the flowers around him go into full bloom.

conditional.dependsOn: His magic pipe (the pipe itself produces songs even when other Fraggles blow into it)

campaignTags.claim: Plays a magic pipe whose music makes flowers bloom.

unknowns: Whether the magic is his or solely the pipe's.

characters.summary: Constantine is the World's Number One Criminal and Kermit's doppelgänger; after escaping a Siberian gulag he takes Kermit's place by disguising his mole and uses the Muppets' tour as cover for heists.
weaknesses: His mole gives him away unless covered; Animal saw through the impersonation
limitations: Relies on deception rather than force

sources.supports: Plot: 'After escaping from a Siberian Gulag, Constantine contacts his subordinate Dominic'; in Berlin he ambushes Kermit, makes him look like the fugitive and has him sent to the Gulag; 'takes Kermit's spot, fooling most of the Muppets (except Animal)'; uses the tour as cover for heists; attacks Walter, Fozzie and Animal, who escape; 'Miss Piggy breaks free and stops Constantine by whacking him all over the place'; Constantine and Dominic are arrested.

Constantine: 'the world's Number One criminal' and 'a doppelgänger of Kermit the Frog'; covers his mole 'with green makeup' to pass as Kermit; slaps a fake mole on Kermit, who is thrown in a Siberian gulag; sets out to steal the Crown Jewels of England.

feats.claim: Impersonated Kermit, fooling most of the Muppets (except Animal), and used their tour as cover for a series of heists.

notableResults.note: Ambushed Kermit in Berlin, framed him with a fake mole and had him sent to the gulag in his place.
Piggy broke free and stopped him by "whacking him all over the place"; he was then arrested.

campaignTags.claim: Impersonated Kermit and took his place among the Muppets, fooling all but Animal.

unknowns: How he escaped the gulag is not described.
No documented sneaking or concealment feat, so the stealth tag was removed.
Hand-to-hand skill beyond the Kermit ambush.

characters.summary: Cookie Monster is a Sesame Street monster with a famous appetite who can and often does eat anything, including flatware, hubcaps and a car fender.
limitations: No strength or fighting feats are documented

sources.supports: Cookie Monster: 'can (and often does) consume anything and everything, from apples and pie to letters, flatware, and hubcaps'; a 1985 Sesame Street Magazine piece cites him eating 'a car fender'; ate Stephen Colbert's Peabody Award on The Colbert Report; no height, strength or fight feats stated.

feats.claim: Eats inedible objects such as flatware, hubcaps, a car fender and Stephen Colbert's Peabody Award.

unknowns: No documented height, so giant-sized was removed.
No strength, smashing or fight feats are documented.
